author: Claude taslak (H-072); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geçmiş zamanda; ilk ve son sayfadaki present perfect cümle (Noah has played second violin for three years) Noah'nın defterine kendisi hakkında yazdığı satırdır. Türkçede 'çalıyor (-dır)' ile verildi: İngilizcedeki 'for + süre + present perfect' Türkçede şimdiki zaman + -dır/-dir ile söylenir.
Parçanın adı Evening Song, Türkçe metinde 'Akşam Şarkısı' olarak çevrildi; kelimeler ayrı ayrı anlamlandırıldı.
Müzik terimleri: violin = keman, cello = viyolonsel, bow = yay, part = parti (bir çalgının çaldığı bölüm), stand = nota sehpası, tune = ezgi; tune a violin = kemanı akort etmek.
Kelime anlamları cümledeki kullanıma göre verildi; düzensiz fiillerde yalın hâli parantez içinde (leave → left).
-ed / -ing sıfatları (disappointed, confused, frightened / exciting, surprising, annoying) kitabın dil odağıdır; anlamlarında ayrıca belirtildi.

lines.en: The Same Chair
Noah has played second violin for three years, and he wants more.
lines.tr: Noah üç yıldır ikinci keman çalıyor ve daha fazlasını istiyor.

lines.en: He wrote that sentence on the first page of a new notebook on a cold Saturday in March.
lines.tr: Bu cümleyi mart ayında, soğuk bir cumartesi günü yeni bir defterin ilk sayfasına yazdı.

lines.en: He wrote it about himself, like a line from a book, because it was easier than writing "I".
lines.tr: Onu kendisi hakkında, bir kitaptan alınmış bir satır gibi yazmıştı, çünkü bu "ben" yazmaktan daha kolaydı.

lines.en: Then he looked at it for a long time.
It was true.
Noah had joined the city youth orchestra when he was twelve.
lines.tr: Noah şehrin gençlik orkestrasına on iki yaşındayken katılmıştı.

lines.en: Since then, he had sat in the same chair every Saturday morning: the third chair on the left, in the second violin section.
lines.tr: O zamandan beri her cumartesi sabahı aynı sandalyede oturmuştu: ikinci keman bölümünde, soldaki üçüncü sandalyede.

lines.en: Behind him, the cellos.
In front of him, the first violins, who always got the beautiful tunes.
lines.tr: Önünde de her zaman güzel ezgileri alan birinci kemanlar.

lines.en: The second violins played the other notes.
The quiet ones under the music.
The notes that nobody ever sang on the way home.
Noah loved the orchestra.
He loved the smell of the old hall and the sound of forty instruments waking up together.
lines.tr: Eski salonun kokusunu ve kırk çalgının birlikte uyanışının sesini seviyordu.

chunks.en: the smell of the old hall

lines.en: But he was fifteen now, and he was tired of the same chair.
lines.tr: Ama artık on beş yaşındaydı ve hep aynı sandalyeden bıkmıştı.

lines.en: That morning, Ms Adeyemi stood at the front of the hall and waited for silence.
lines.tr: O sabah Bayan Adeyemi salonun önünde durdu ve sessizliği bekledi.

chunks.en: at the front of the hall

lines.en: She was the conductor, a tall woman with grey hair and bright orange glasses.
lines.tr: Orkestra şefiydi; gri saçlı, parlak turuncu gözlüklü, uzun boylu bir kadın.

lines.en: She never shouted.
She only waited, and somehow that was worse.
lines.tr: Sadece beklerdi ve nedense bu daha kötüydü.

lines.en: "I have some exciting news," she said.
lines.tr: "Size heyecan verici bir haberim var," dedi.

lines.en: "This summer, our concert will finish with a new piece.
lines.tr: "Bu yaz konserimiz yeni bir parçayla bitecek.

lines.en: It's called Evening Song, and it has a solo for one violin."
lines.tr: Adı Akşam Şarkısı ve içinde tek keman için bir solo var."

lines.en: Forty young musicians started talking at once.
lines.tr: Kırk genç müzisyen aynı anda konuşmaya başladı.

lines.en: "The audition is in three weeks," Ms Adeyemi said.
lines.tr: "Seçme üç hafta sonra," dedi Bayan Adeyemi.

lines.en: "Anyone can try.
First violin or second."
lines.tr: Birinci keman da olur, ikinci de."

lines.en: Noah felt his heart jump.
Anyone.
Even the third chair on the left.
On the bus home, he wrote in his notebook again.
lines.tr: Eve giden otobüste defterine yine yazdı.

lines.en: If I practise every day, I will get the solo.
Then he added a second line, smaller.
lines.tr: Sonra daha küçük harflerle ikinci bir satır ekledi.

lines.en: If I don't get nervous.
That was the problem.
Noah could play well in his bedroom.
On a stage, his hands started to shake.
The next Saturday, there was a new girl in the hall.
lines.tr: Sonraki cumartesi salonda yeni bir kız vardı.

lines.en: She was standing near the door with a violin case in her arms, as if she wanted to protect it.
lines.tr: Kapının yanında duruyordu; keman kutusunu sanki korumak istermiş gibi kollarına almıştı.

chunks.en: as if she wanted to protect it

lines.en: She had short black hair and a serious face, and she was wearing a green coat that was too big for her.
lines.tr: Kısa siyah saçları ve ciddi bir yüzü vardı; üstünde ona fazla büyük gelen yeşil bir palto vardı.

lines.en: "This is Hana," said Ms Adeyemi.
"She has just moved here from another city.
She'll sit with the second violins for now."
Hana sat down in the empty chair next to Noah.
lines.tr: Hana, Noah'nın yanındaki boş sandalyeye oturdu.

lines.en: She didn't say hello.
She just opened her case and started to tune her violin.
lines.tr: Sadece kutusunu açtı ve kemanını akort etmeye başladı.

lines.en: Then Ms Adeyemi asked her to play something alone, so that everyone could hear her.
lines.tr: Sonra Bayan Adeyemi, herkes duyabilsin diye ondan tek başına bir şey çalmasını istedi.

chunks.en: so that everyone could hear her

lines.en: Hana stood up.
She closed her eyes.
And she played.
Noah had never heard anything like it.
lines.tr: Noah böyle bir şeyi daha önce hiç duymamıştı.

lines.en: The sound was warm and clear, and it seemed to fill every corner of the old hall.
lines.tr: Ses sıcak ve berraktı; eski salonun her köşesini dolduruyor gibiydi.

lines.en: When she stopped, nobody spoke.
Even the cellos were silent.
"Well," said Ms Adeyemi quietly.
"Thank you, Hana."
During the break, everyone wanted to talk to the new girl.
lines.tr: Arada herkes yeni kızla konuşmak istedi.

lines.en: Ruby, who was the leader of the first violins, asked her where she had studied.
lines.tr: Birinci kemanların başı olan Ruby, ona nerede eğitim aldığını sordu.

lines.en: A boy from the cellos asked if she had ever played on the radio.
lines.tr: Viyolonsellerden bir oğlan, daha önce hiç radyoda çalıp çalmadığını sordu.

lines.en: Hana answered with one or two words and looked at the floor.
lines.tr: Hana bir iki kelimeyle cevap verdi ve yere baktı.

lines.en: Noah stayed in his chair.
He didn't want to talk to her.
He felt something heavy and unpleasant in his chest, and he didn't like it.
lines.tr: Göğsünde ağır, hoş olmayan bir şey hissetti ve bundan hoşlanmadı.

lines.en: She is better than me, he thought.
She is better than everyone here.
She'll get the solo, and I'll stay in the same chair for another three years.
lines.tr: Soloyu o alacak, ben de üç yıl daha aynı sandalyede kalacağım.

lines.en: On the bus, he didn't write anything in his notebook.
He just looked out of the window at the grey streets and felt disappointed with the whole world.
lines.tr: Sadece pencereden gri sokaklara baktı ve bütün dünyaya karşı hayal kırıklığı hissetti.

lines.en: He was also a little ashamed.
Hana hadn't done anything wrong.
She had only played well.
After that, Noah started arriving early so that he could practise alone in a small room behind the hall.
lines.tr: Ondan sonra Noah, salonun arkasındaki küçük bir odada tek başına çalışabilmek için erken gelmeye başladı.

chunks.en: so that he could practise alone

lines.en: It was the quietest place in the building.
On the third Saturday, he was walking towards that room when he heard a violin.
lines.tr: Üçüncü cumartesi o odaya doğru yürürken bir keman sesi duydu.

lines.en: Someone was playing Evening Song.
The music was slow and soft, and so beautiful that Noah stopped walking.
lines.tr: Müzik yavaş ve yumuşaktı; o kadar güzeldi ki Noah yürümeyi bıraktı.

lines.en: He stood very still and listened.
It was Hana.
He knew her sound already.
But this was different from her playing in the hall.
lines.tr: Ama bu, onun salondaki çalışından farklıydı.

lines.en: It was softer, freer, as if she was playing only for herself.
lines.tr: Daha yumuşak, daha özgürdü; sanki yalnızca kendisi için çalıyormuş gibi.

chunks.en: as if she was playing only for herself
chunks.tr: sanki yalnızca kendisi için çalıyormuş gibi

lines.en: Noah moved closer.
The floor under his foot made a small noise.
Suddenly the music stopped.
He knocked and opened the door.
Hana was standing by the window with her violin under her arm.
lines.tr: Hana, kemanı koltuğunun altında, pencerenin yanında duruyordu.

lines.en: Her face was white.
"Sorry," said Noah.
"I didn't mean to listen."
Hana didn't answer.
She put her violin back in its case quickly, picked up her coat and walked past him without a word.
lines.tr: Kemanını hızla kutusuna koydu, paltosunu aldı ve tek kelime etmeden yanından geçip gitti.

lines.en: The Audition
On the day of the audition, it was raining.
Noah had slept badly, and his hands were cold.
lines.tr: Noah kötü uyumuştu ve elleri soğuktu.

lines.en: Twelve students were waiting outside the small room.
lines.tr: On iki öğrenci küçük odanın önünde bekliyordu.

lines.en: Ms Adeyemi was inside, sitting at a table with a pencil and a cup of tea.
lines.tr: Bayan Adeyemi içerideydi; elinde bir kalem, önünde bir fincan çayla bir masada oturuyordu.

lines.en: They had to go in one by one.
Hana was sitting at the end of the row.

lines.en: She was holding her violin case so tightly that her fingers were pale.
lines.tr: Keman kutusunu öyle sıkı tutuyordu ki parmakları bembeyaz olmuştu.

lines.en: Noah was surprised.
She looked more frightened than anyone.
Ruby went first.
She came out smiling.
Then a girl from the first violins went in, and then a boy who played very fast and very loudly.
lines.tr: Sonra birinci kemanlardan bir kız girdi, ardından da çok hızlı ve çok yüksek sesle çalan bir oğlan.

lines.en: While Noah was waiting, he tried to remember something his grandpa used to say.
lines.tr: Noah beklerken dedesinin eskiden söylediği bir şeyi hatırlamaya çalıştı.

lines.en: Grandpa had played the piano in cafés when he was young.
"Don't play for the people who are judging you," he used to tell Noah.
lines.tr: "Seni yargılayan insanlar için çalma," derdi Noah'ya.

lines.en: "Play for the one person in the room who needs the music."
lines.tr: "Odada müziğe ihtiyacı olan o tek kişi için çal."

lines.en: Then a door opened, and somebody said his name.
lines.tr: Sonra bir kapı açıldı ve biri onun adını söyledi.

lines.en: Noah's hands shook when he lifted his violin.
For a moment, he thought he might not be able to start.

lines.en: He played.
It wasn't perfect.
His bow shook a little on the long notes, and he played one note too early.
lines.tr: Uzun notalarda yayı biraz titredi ve bir notayı fazla erken çaldı.

lines.en: But the tune was there, and in some places it was even beautiful.
lines.tr: Ama ezgi oradaydı ve bazı yerlerde güzel bile sayılırdı.

Hana walked out to the front of the stage.
